# GitAnalyzer

> GitAnalyzer evaluates GitHub commit messages and repository history, then provides clear, rule-based feedback and optional diff-grounded AI suggestions.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://gitanalyzer-ai.netlify.app/): Analyze a public GitHub user or repository.
- [Commit workshop](https://gitanalyzer-ai.netlify.app/workshop): Draft, score, and improve a commit message using a supplied git diff.

## Capabilities

- Score commit-message clarity, structure, consistency, context, and hygiene.
- Identify recurring repository-level issues and practical next actions.
- Review individual commits and generate AI-improved messages from their GitHub diffs for signed-in users.
- Create a shareable repository analysis URL and download a PDF report.

## Notes

- Public GitHub repositories and users can be analyzed without an account.
- AI suggestions require sign-in and use a monthly per-account allowance.
